line: Welcome to the Meridian Mall, folks! Tonight's main event: one courier versus a whole lot of hungry neighbours.
It's an arena, Parker. You don't have to fight. Just get through it.
Open the gates! Let 'em out!
Those ones jump. Watch the ledges up top, not the floor.
Careful. Every shot you fire brings more of them.
And he's into the food court! Sorry, folks, food court's closed. Has been for twenty years.
This segment is brought to you by the Ward. Clean water, for people who know their place.
He made it to the anchor store! Folks, I'm entertained, and I'm furious about it.
Department store. There's a roof hatch, top floor, back corner. Up you go.
Big lads with the shields. Get round 'em, or shoot what the shield doesn't cover.
That drone's spotting you for the shooters. Knock it down if you can.
Now, Parker, while you're browsing, a word from our... what is that? Who's on my frequency?
Keep the porch light on, courier. I'm coming home.
Technical difficulties, folks. Nobody touch anything.
That was her.

He's on the roof! And guess who's waiting for him over at the car park. Go on. Guess.

Hey, Parker. Long time. Still running for other people?
Still running.
These ones run like you. They'll come at you from the side. Don't stop.
You were always faster. I'm the one getting paid, though.

Come on, then. Show the city.
Go on. Get her. Before I change my mind.
...She was one of ours, once. Keep going.
Well. Ratings are through the roof. And you're all cheering for the wrong guy. Every one of you.
Let's, uh... let's take a quick break. Word from our sponsor.

Parker. Those aren't raiders.
Channels go straight to the west side. That's Ward land. Their water, too. Be quick.

Fresh orange. That's not my mark. Somebody's out there marking you a route, Parker.
Courier sighted. Squad two, close the sluice line.
These ones work in teams. They don't miss twice. Don't give them a still target.
Helmets. First shot knocks it off. Second one counts.
The big Hollow's armoured on the front. Get behind it.
Quick reminder from the sponsor, folks: water's a privilege. Parker's probably drinking some right now. For free.
The courier is not to reach the tower. Whatever it costs.

Old train line. Last straight road to the tower.
New rule tonight, folks! I'm changing the route as we go. Let's see how he likes that.
Oh no. Section nine's gone. Oh well.
Drones. With guns. Watch for the flash before they fire. One hit and they drop.
See that? The Ward won't go anywhere near the Static. They hate each other. Use it.
My crew and the sponsor's boys don't really... mix. Bit of history. Don't ask.
Go left at the junction, courier. Left! The right track just ends.
Who keeps doing that?
Host, you were paid to end this.
And I'm paid to make it a good show, Commander. I can do both.
There's the tower. Up you go, kid.
That's Calder House. Radio people built it, back when radio was a job. He runs the show from in there.
Big treat tonight, folks. I'm coming down to say hello. In person! Don't wait up.
There he is! Huh. You're smaller in real life.
That's him. That's actually him. Don't chase him into anything stupid.
Ow! Ow. Okay. That's coming out of your fee.
Will somebody shoot him? I pay you people!
Back in five, folks. Don't touch that dial.
You were told to stay in the studio.
And you were told this'd be an easy contract, Commander. We've all been lied to.
His office is on this floor. Corner one. It's always the corner one.
Look at this. You've tracked mud all over my carpet.
Right. I'm leaving. Upstairs, everybody. And bring the wife.
He's going up. Echo's up there, Parker. She has to be.
Top floors, then the roof. There's a bridge across to the tower up there. If they're moving her, that's how.
Folks, small update. I'm bleeding a bit. Show goes on.
Careful in here! Twenty years of my best work. Don't you touch it.
Prepare the transfer. Nobody crosses that bridge after her.
Rifles on the tanks. Stay low, keep moving, you're nearly there.
Parker. I see her. On the bridge. Go!
Parker? Oh my god. Parker.
Hey. Hey, I've got you.
No, you don't. Listen. They're taking me up to the studio, he wants you watching when—
Take her across. Blow the bridge.
The scaffold! Come up the outside, they never watch the outside!
Ooh. Sorry, folks. Bit of a technical problem there. Stay with us.
Parker? Parker, talk to me.
I'm okay. I'm going up.
Ten minutes, folks. That's how long he's got. After that, well. Ask his wife.
I'm coming, Echo.
Don't look down. Look up, that's where they're shooting from.

Get her off my uplink! GET HER OFF!
Gun drones just went dark. That was her! Climb, Parker!
Three minutes! Two! I don't even know anymore!
Fine. Fine! Come on in. Studio's open. Mind the step.

All units to the studio. This ends tonight.
Echo.
You're late.
Traffic.

Port Calder... the grand finale.
Parker! Parker, you're pinned. The whole floor's on fire.
Draw him off me. Run. I'll talk you down.
Line camp to anyone out there. They made it. Both of them.
Port Calder, it's Echo. And Parker. The show's over.
Go outside. It's a nice day.
Not bad, courier. Not bad.
Helmet's off. Finish it.
Clean.

Clean.

Mind the gap, Parker! Seriously. I blew it up.
